dynamics.method: filled lower Bloch band at theta=0; hbar=1; unitary midpoint SU(2) propagation; electron current -dH/dk; midpoint time integral and periodic k average

finiteChain.method: half-filled open Rice-Mele chain; all occupied orbitals evolved by Hermitian midpoint propagators; electron bond current and midpoint central-bond charge; no periodic edge wrap

analysis.method: occupied-band FHS torus and independent k-Wilson-loop polarization winding; periodic seams included
